## Description {#details}

<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/immutablepass">ImmutablePass</a> class - This class is used to provide information that does not need to be run.</p>


<p>This is useful for things like target information.</p>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>initializePass - This method may be overriden by immutable passes to allow them to perform various initialization actions they require.</p>


<p>This is primarily because an <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/immutablepass">ImmutablePass</a> can "require" another <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/immutablepass">ImmutablePass</a>, and if it does, the overloaded version of initializePass may get access to these passes with getAnalysis&lt;&gt;.</p>
